SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: God of war, plague, death, and underworld embodying destructive power, pestilence, and fierce sovereignty of the dead
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The burning fever and violence of war - death's aggressive masculine face

DevelopmentalArc: War God → Offense to Gods → Descent to Underworld → Combat with Ereshkigal → Marriage → Co-Ruler of Dead
NarrativeRoles.CyclePhase: Aggression → Descent → Conflict → Union → Dark Sovereignty

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked in war, plague prevention/sending, death rituals, underworld sovereignty, protective amulets against his power
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Originally solar/war deity, became associated with plague and death, merged with underworld rulership, syncretized with Erra (destruction)

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted with lion, wielding weapons, crowned as underworld king, with Ereshkigal, fierce and martial, pestilence symbols
ArtisticExamples: Cylinder seals showing Nergal with lion
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the fever that burns cities, the sword that knows no mercy, the king who conquered death herself and took her throne.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Armies of plague demons; descending to fight the death queen and winning her hand; burning everything with fever and war

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for destructive power, war magic, confronting death, fierce sovereignty, plague work (carefully)
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a god of war and plague who conquers death itself through fierce combat, who rules darkness with violent sovereignty.
Create a destroyer who brings sickness and sword, who won the underworld queen through strength.
NarrativeHooks: The warrior who becomes king of the dead
